position: Commander of the third Infantry Division of the Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA)

name: Peter GADET
alias: Peter Gatdet Yaka; Peter Cadet; Peter Gadet Yak; Peter Gadet Yaak; Peter Gatdet Yaak; Peter Gatdet; Peter Gatdeet Yaka
position: Leader of the anti-government Nuer militia
reason: Peter Gadet is leader of the anti-government Nuer militia that conducted an attack on Bentiu on 15-17 April 2014, in violation of the 23 January Cessation of Hostilities Agreement. The attack resulted in the killing of more than 200 civilians. Peter Gadet is thus responsible for fuelling the cycle of violence, thus obstructing the political process in South Sudan, and for serious human rights violations
